questions.question: Why do people need a supply of clean water? Give three reasons.
questions.expected_answer: People can only survive a few days without water, so we need it to drink. We also need it to cook, wash ourselves and our clothes, flush toilets and clean. It must be clean, because dirty water can carry germs that cause water-borne illnesses like cholera and diarrhoea. A tap nearby also saves people, often women and girls, the time spent fetching water.

questions.question: Why do plants, animals and farms need clean water?
questions.expected_answer: Plants need water for photosynthesis, to carry minerals from the soil and to stay firm. Animals need clean water to drink, and fish, frogs and insects need clean water with enough oxygen to live in. Farms use most of South Africa's water to irrigate crops and keep animals healthy, and polluted water can damage crops and soil and make people ill.

questions.question: What does it mean that South Africa is water-scarce? Give three ways to save water.
questions.expected_answer: It means there is not much water to share for everyone's needs, because the country gets less rain than most and much water evaporates; droughts make it worse, as in Cape Town's Day Zero crisis. Ways to save water include turning off the tap while brushing teeth, fixing leaks, taking short showers, using a bucket to wash a car, watering gardens in the cool evening and collecting rainwater.
